subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: After the correctness defects are repaired, should `append` become a durable model-facing capability of the core `write` tool?
rationale: The canonical reports show strong user value, but adding a new core tool input creates a lasting model and integration contract that repository policy reserves for maintainer product judgment.

options.title: Approve opt-in core append
options.body: Keep overwrite as the default, repair the cross-backend safety contract, and expose `append: true` as the supported accumulation path.

options.title: Keep core overwrite-only
options.body: Decline this API and pursue a separate append tool or a narrower owner-specific workflow instead.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in core append
recommendation.body: Keep overwrite as the default, repair the cross-backend safety contract, and expose `append: true` as the supported accumulation path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available current-main history signal for the affected write and sandbox paths, though final product authority is not established by history alone.
